svg.title: Two-condition training and ensemble-based candidate selection
svg.desc: Workflow schematic. A: each sampled parameter vector is simulated once under the Fgf4 knockout and once in the wild type, giving one joint 49-value score trajectory. B: neural estimators are fitted to parameter-score pairs and conditioned on the ideal all-ones target. C: ten tasks, two independently initialized fits per task, each giving a candidate MAP. D: for Task 1, Task 2 and Task 10, the retained fit of each task is evaluated with 50 paired simulations, giving example scores S = 0.89, 0.83 and 0.97; S selects within each task and then across tasks, and the best task (S = 0.97) is chosen; the selected estimator's goal-conditioned density is the next proposal. Example values and curves are illustrative.
